name: Jalgiri Mahal at Neemrana Fort-Palace
why_it_matters: Main multi-cuisine dining room of Neemrana Fort-Palace, the 15th-century fort restoration that essentially defined the heritage-hotel category in north India. Buffet menu rotates Rajasthani / North-Indian core with French, Italian, Chinese, Thai, South Indian supplements.
insider_tip: Day-trippers from Delhi can book a lunch package that includes a fort tour, pool access and the buffet — must reserve a day ahead via the Neemrana booking line.
signature_address: Neemrana Fort-Palace, Delhi-Jaipur Highway (NH-8), Neemrana, Alwar District, Rajasthan 301705

name: Raj Mahal Bar at Neemrana Fort-Palace
why_it_matters: Fort-rampart bar inside Neemrana Fort-Palace — the only 'pub' setting on the property, run alongside the main dining hall. Stays open later than the kitchen and serves the candlelit-couples sundowner the property is known for.
insider_tip: Bar service on the open ramparts depends on weather — if there's wind, they shift inside without warning. Tip: sit indoors first, then walk out with the drink.
signature_address: Raj Mahal Bar, Neemrana Fort-Palace, Delhi-Jaipur Highway, Neemrana, Alwar District, Rajasthan 301705
